claims.subject: Müller Gruppe
claims.claim: Müller Gruppe names Müller Fleisch GmbH, Bayreuther Fleisch GmbH, Ulmer Fleisch GmbH, Ingolstädter Fleisch GmbH and Süddeutsches Schweinefleischzentrum GmbH as companies in its southern German group network.
claims.boundary: A group listing does not collapse the separate legal entities or prove identical ownership and operator roles at all sites.
claims.falsification_condition: A current corporate disclosure materially changes the group-company list.

claims.subject: Müller Gruppe
claims.claim: Müller Gruppe reports that more than 320,000 cattle and 2.1 million pigs are slaughtered, cut and marketed annually across its locations.
claims.boundary: This is a company-reported group throughput figure and not a direct measure of animal suffering or legal responsibility.
claims.falsification_condition: A newer audited, official or company disclosure materially changes the annual figures.

claims.subject: Müller Fleisch GmbH
claims.claim: Müller Fleisch GmbH reports approximately €500 million annual revenue and about 1,000 employees.
claims.boundary: Revenue and employee counts do not quantify animal throughput, profit or welfare outcomes.
claims.falsification_condition: A newer company or authoritative filing materially changes these scale figures.

claims.subject: Müller Fleisch GmbH
claims.object: about 120,000 cattle/year and 1 million pigs/year at Ulm for Müller Fleisch
claims.claim: Müller Fleisch GmbH reports a slaughter volume of about 120,000 cattle per year and about one million pigs per year at the Ulm location for Müller Fleisch.
claims.boundary: This company-reported figure does not identify individual farms, shipments, product brands or customers.
claims.falsification_condition: A newer official, audited or company disclosure materially changes the site/species volume.

claims.subject: Müller Gruppe
claims.object: producers, producer groups, livestock traders and supply/offtake contracts
claims.claim: Müller Gruppe states that it works with producers, producer groups and private livestock traders and sources a large share of slaughter animals through supply and offtake contracts.
claims.boundary: The supplier model does not identify a named farm-to-slaughterhouse shipment or prove the terms of a particular contract.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company disclosure materially changes the sourcing/contract model.

claims.subject: Müller Gruppe
claims.object: Haltungsform 3 cow premium to €0.30/kg slaughter weight from 1 April 2026
claims.claim: Müller Gruppe announced that from 1 April 2026 it would raise its Haltungsform 3 premium for eligible cows to 30 cents per kilogram of slaughter weight and stated that related contract models run through producer groups and private livestock traders.
claims.source_title: Müller Gruppe — Haltungsform 3 Zuschläge werden erhöht
claims.boundary: A premium and contract model do not prove participation by all suppliers or measured improvement in animal-based welfare outcomes.
claims.falsification_condition: A newer company programme rule changes the premium, eligibility or contract model.
